# A correspondence discipline for conditions

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Interaction alone relates through a condition; idle conditions no longer connect for free, and connection is made by living use.

`condition-correspondence-discipline` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

On the stepwise reading of a web, keep living (active and not undermining) and narrow related from co-participation to interaction: two events are related through a condition only when one draws on it and the other depends on it at a positive level, at any steps (neither order in time nor change of level enters). A condition that no activity draws on, or no dependence on which can fail, is idle: it relates nothing and undermines nothing, and adjoining one leaves living, the relation and connection unchanged. So the free connection of the independent review's Q4 is excluded: adjoining a condition every formation requires at level zero and nothing draws on connects every web under co-participation and leaves connection unchanged under interaction. Every undermining relation is an interaction; under relational neutrality, a standpoint valuing an undermining event holds significant the living events of the formation it undermines at every step where that formation depends on the condition at a positive level. The transmission is carried by drawing, not undermining: a standpoint valuing any drawing event holds significant every living event depending on the condition at a positive level (drawing_reaches), so only the co-dependence half of review Q5 is excluded. A condition that every living event draws on or depends on at a positive level, with a living drawer and a living dependent, connects the whole, any two living events being linked in at most two interactions; living significance there is exactly a seed with relational and standpoint neutrality. In one example two formations depending on one condition are connected through a use that keeps their support, and not when the only use undermines it, while co-participation connects them in both runs. Adjoining a renewed condition on which every formation depends at a positive level, used once by one living event, still connects every web under interaction without changing living (one_use_connects); every formation drawing on it is not needed. No Lean axiom is used and no ethical predicate is added.

Canonical source: [Correspondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Correspondence.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The web and the stepwise reading are those of becoming-stepwise-reading; draws carries no amount; like co-participation, interaction does not order the two events in time, and it does not ask whether the drawing changes the level (Later, Pinned.drawing_interacts).
- The connection result needs a condition on which every living event bears, with a living drawer and a living dependent; the characterization also needs some living event; the transmission result needs N_rel, whose normative standing this result does not prove.

The discipline is a disclosed correspondence choice, not a consequence of the unfolding. Interaction is a structural coincidence: one draws on, and the other depends at a positive level on, one condition that can fail it, at any steps. It is not yet one formation's drawing bearing on another's support; that needs an ordered, effect-sensitive version, which is open. Co-dependence, two formations depending on one condition, is a relation the discipline omits (co-constitution through a common condition), not an absence of relation; Shared exhibits the cost of omitting it, and an application that counts it must write it out. The discipline excludes conditions that structurally cannot carry interaction, not false claims of drawing or dependence: a renewed condition on which every formation depends at a positive level, used once by a living event, is indistinguishable on the web from a genuine common condition (say, the air everyone breathes), and the connection it gives is a factual claim that application must check. The co-participation choice and its consequence (Q4) remain on the core; on Ren's delegation interaction is kept (D10).

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

Stated for the stepwise reading only; with fixed dependences it applies through K.dependence.along r, and the whole-run reading could take the same relation, which is not done here. Does not order events in time or ask about the effect of drawing; does not change living; chooses no reading; yields no responsibility or duty.

- The discipline does not exclude a renewed condition that every formation draws on and depends on at a positive level (universal_connects): adjoining one leaves living unchanged and connects every web. [Correspondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Correspondence.lean)
- The discipline's cost (Shared.connection_by_living_use): when the only use undermines the dependents, they are not connected to each other through the condition, while co-participation connects them. [Correspondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Correspondence.lean)
- Review Q10 is not resolved: a coarse common condition that every formation draws on withholds the events drawing on it once a dependence on it fails; the discipline changes relations, not living. [BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING-REVIEW.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING-REVIEW.md)
- The residual free connection is cheaper than “everyone draws on it” (Web.one_use_connects): for any web with a living event, adjoining a condition on which every formation depends at level 1, drawn on once by that event's formation at its step, keeps the condition renewed and living unchanged and connects the web under interaction (independent review G8). [Correspondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Correspondence.lean)
- Interaction does not order time (Later.drawing_connects_earlier): a drawing at step 5 interacts with, and connects, a dependence held only at step 0, which it cannot bear on (independent review G7). [Correspondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Correspondence.lean)
- Interaction does not ask about effect (Pinned.drawing_interacts): the drawer's event interacts with the old dependent, though the two runs that draw and rest have the same levels everywhere (independent review G7). [Correspondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Correspondence.lean)
- Only half of review Q5 is excluded (Web.drawing_reaches): under relational neutrality a standpoint valuing any drawing event holds significant every living event depending on the condition at a positive level, whether or not the drawing undermines anything (independent review G9). [Correspondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Correspondence.lean)
- Independent review: every declaration under review is accepted with empty axiom reports; MetSince had to compare the need at that step (repaired), a one-step lapse starts a new tenure (disclosed), and but-for needs the move to be available (repaired); the prose overclaimed on the stepwise cost, restraint, substitution, interaction and the residual free connection (corrected in the integration note). Stated in a new section of the same module.
